kept.spine: Governing here is the elders coming to a common mind, and what the Free Elder Council asks of the hamlet is heard and not done.
A pedlar says a question put to the Free Elder Council comes back unanswered, and the same question put to somebody here with no title at all is settled by evening.

kept.spine: The Free Elder Council governs at Warmholz, and anything that is not one household's own business is put to it.

kept.poolKey: capture pressure ADVANCING (weak security, poor prosperity)
kept.spine: Nothing here has been bought yet, and nothing here would cost much to buy: safety is the sorest thing the people hold against their governing, and prosperity the next. Whoever offered to pay for the safety here would be owed something for it, and it would be worth knowing whether anyone has offered.
A decision here is talked flat before it is taken, and what the Free Elder Council has once settled it does not readily unsettle.
